generated.description: A large sandstone terrace complex with layered tiers, oak trees and leaf canopies, water channels, and grassy planters spilling down the sides, in the style of the legendary Hanging Gardens. Built mostly from about 105,000 sandstone blocks with oak leaves and logs for greenery, plus some red wool, gold blocks, and ice accents. At 116 by 49 by 116 blocks, it is a very large build with no interior and no description from the author.
